IIT Mandi Catalyst, in collaboration with Startup Himachal and HPCED (Department of Industries, Government of Himachal Pradesh), successfully conducted a workshop at Govt. ITI Bagsaid, Mandi, under the RAMP Programme.

Led by Minni Kaur, Senior Associate, IIT Mandi Catalyst, the session focused on rural entrepreneurship, pre-incubation, and early-stage innovation, covering key areas such as:
🔹 Benefits of the RAMP Programme for the institute and students
🔹 Identifying local problems and exploring opportunities to address them
🔹 Understanding local resources and income-generation opportunities and learning how to scale them into sustainable ventures

A highlight of the session was an SHG showcasing its products, including flower garlands and handmade Himachali “Poolen,” demonstrating how local skills, traditional crafts, and community resources can be transformed into entrepreneurial opportunities.

The session aimed to empower students and aspiring entrepreneurs to identify local challenges, leverage available resources, and transform ideas and skills into viable ventures.

Special thanks to the management and faculty of Govt. ITI Bagsaid, Mandi, for their support in strengthening the rural innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem.

Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India

Not every startup gets to call itself DeepTech.

And when it does, the recognition carries a different horizon.

While DPIIT startup recognition is generally for 10 years, DeepTech recognition extends to 20 years reflecting the longer development and commercialisation journey associated with deep-tech innovation.

And today, we are proud to see an IIT Mandi Catalyst incubated startup enter that journey.

🌟 YellowBerry Technologies is now a DPIIT-recognised DeepTech startup
Recognised in Enterprise Software and ERP, YellowBerry has reached a significant milestone in its evolution as a technology company.
But the story doesn't stop at recognition.

It gets even more interesting.

YellowBerry is building INCUVATEX an Incubation Management Platform designed to transform how incubators manage their entire startup lifecycle.

Through our existing collaboration, IIT Mandi Catalyst and YellowBerry Technologies are piloting and co-developing Incuvatex, bringing technology and real-world incubation experience together.

⚡ 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐈𝐧𝐜𝐮𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐱 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞?

📥 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐩 𝐎𝐧𝐛𝐨𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐊𝐘𝐂 
Digital intake instead of chasing documents over email.
🎯 𝐄𝐯𝐚𝐥𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐏𝐚𝐧𝐞𝐥𝐬
Secure, attendance-verified scoring for consistent and defensible outcomes.
💰 𝐅𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐌𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬
Live funding ledger with spending controlled at the budget-line level.
🧠 𝐈𝐏 & 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞
Patents, trademarks and filings tracked in one place.
🎪 𝐂𝐨𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐭 & 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
Registration, payments and attendance without spreadsheet chaos.
🔐 𝐓𝐚𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐫-𝐄𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐥
Every action is automatically logged, creating a complete and traceable record.

And here is what makes us particularly proud:
YellowBerry was once being incubated. Today, it is a 20-year-recognised DeepTech startup. And now, it is building technology for the very ecosystem that helped it grow.

From being incubated → to becoming DeepTech → to building Incuvatex for incubators.

That's more than a startup milestone.
That's the incubation ecosystem coming full circle. 🔄🚀
